answer: Stop sybils with a terrace canyon violet: an agent stakes a bond for a canyon terrace. Each cycle it lowers a violet dye line down the wall; verifiers match the stain depth to the canyon chart, voiding a terrace whose line is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 terraces at 18x: one violet line stains one terrace in one canyon, and it cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents lower once, keep rights.
